description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the ImmutableStack<T> collection type in Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: ImmutableStackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableStack<T> providing conversion to and from a surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableStackSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate data structure for serializing ImmutableStack<T>.

methods.name: ImmutableStackCodec<T>.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts surrogate data back into an ImmutableStack<T>.

methods.name: ImmutableStackCodec<T>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableStack<T> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: ImmutableStackCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableStack<T>, handling cyclic references and shallow copying when necessary.
